claims.evidence: Witness report confirms wide tires and a fat bike configuration.
While mudguards are present, other standard accessories like lights, locks, or tools are not mentioned in the report.

risks.risk: Seized or poorly indexed gear shifting.
risks.proof: A video clip of the bike being pedaled while shifting through all gears.
risks.if_unproven: as a single-speed bike with a broken derailleur.

risks.risk: Structural instability or play in the central folding hinge.
risks.proof: A close-up video of the hinge being locked and then stressed by hand to show no movement.
risks.if_unproven: as a damaged frame with a safety hazard.

risks.risk: Ineffective disc brakes or worn-out pads.
risks.proof: A video showing the bike being ridden and coming to a sharp stop using both brakes.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full brake system replacement.

risks.risk: Internal rust or cracks in the suspension components.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the fork stanchions and rear shock pivot points.
risks.if_unproven: as a rigid frame with non-functional suspension.

proof_requests: Video of the gear shifting mechanism in operation.
Video of the folding hinge being opened and closed.
Close-up photo of the brake calipers and disc rotors.
Video of the bike being ridden to test the suspension and brakes.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the item as a MAGISIE folding fat bike, allowing for a baseline valuation at its worst-case mechanical state.
